newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Qpod to raise NZ$3.2 mln in public offer.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Qpod to raise NZ$3.2 mln in public offer.

text.p: New Zealand-based food storage and transport technology company Qpod Systems Ltd said on Tuesday it aimed to raise NZ$3.2 million through a public share offer in Australia and New Zealand.
A company spokesman said there were no immediate plans for a stock exchange listing.

The company is seeking to raise the funds through the issue of 1.8 million ordinary shares at NZ$1.75/share. It is projecting sales of over NZ$30 million during the next five years and to achieve a maiden $1.18 million profit and become cashflow positive in 1998/99.
Pre-tax profit of nearly $10 million is projected for 2000/01.
